cards.ex: I only invited a handful of friends to my party.
cards.exUz: Men faqat bir hovuch do'stlarimni partimga taklif qildim.
cards.uzDef: Kam miqdordagi narsalar yoki odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: I need a couple of days to finish the report.
cards.exUz: Hisobotni tugatish uchun menga bir necha kun kerak.

cards.ex: I have a ton of work to do this week.
cards.exUz: Bu hafta meni juda ko'p ishim bor.

cards.ex: Are you going to the concert? Count me in!

cards.exUz: Odamlar mitingga ko'p sonli kelishdi.

cards.ex: The project is more or less finished.

cards.exUz: Taxminan bir soat vaqt ketadi, bir necha daqiqa plus minus.

cards.ex: I can give you a rough estimate of the cost.
cards.exUz: Men sizga xarajatlarning taxminiy bahosini berishim mumkin.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the renovations?
cards.exUz: Ta'mirlash uchun taxminiy raqamni ayta olasizmi?

cards.ex: Let's just split the bill, it's easier that way.
cards.exUz: Keling, hisobni bo'lishamiz, shunday osonroq.

cards.ex: The numbers don't add up; there must be a mistake.
cards.exUz: Raqamlar qo'shilib chiqmayapti; xato bo'lishi kerak.

cards.exUz: Mening hissam shunchaki kichik bir qism edi.

cards.exUz: Odamlarning katta qismi yangi qonun uchun ovoz berdi.

cards.exUz: Biz xarajatlarimizni qisqartirishimiz kerak.

cards.exUz: Bu qancha turishini aniqlashim kerak.

cards.exUz: Taxminan aytsak, ikki soat vaqt ketadi.

cards.ex: Let's zero in on the key issues.
cards.exUz: Keling, asosiy masalalarga diqqatni qarataylik.

cards.exUz: Men taklif berishdan oldin raqobatchilarni baholadim.

cards.ex: That car must have cost an arm and a leg.
cards.exUz: Bu mashina juda qimmat turgan bo'lsa kerak.

cards.uzDef: Juda qimmat turmoq; katta pulga aylanish.
